Logical Model: GetImagingOutcome

Official URL: https://fhir.inera.se/ig/clinicalprocess-healthcond-actoutcome/StructureDefinition/getimagingoutcome Version: 1.0
Active as of 2026-10-08 Computable Name: GetImagingOutcome

Copyright/Legal: Copyright 2024 Inera AB. Licensieras under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

Logisk modell för tjänstekontraktet GetImagingOutcome 1.0 (RIV-TA urn:riv:clinicalprocess:healthcond:actoutcome:GetImagingOutcomeResponder:1). Representerar svarets (response) informationsstruktur enligt fältreglerna i TKB 3.1.10, avsnitt 7.4.

Usages:

  • This Logical Model is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
